description: Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) and Nodal Station Measurements of the Birds Landing Transmission Tower Implosion is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Brady Cox, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). The Birds Landing Transmission Tower Implosion Project, conducted by Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E) as a part of their transmission line replacement project, involved the controlled collapse of two large electrical transmission towers near the Sacramento River Delta in California. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 4 top-level files (PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-98zn-9b02. Keywords: Distributed Acoustic Sensing, DAS, nodal stations, fiber optic cable, horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios. Published 2026-07-23. Facility named: Mobile Field Shakers - University of Texas at Austin. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
